key_points_correct: Good SPIFFE/SPIRE design with cross-environment federation via SVIDs
Covers AWS IAM, Azure Managed Identity, and on-prem PKI integration
Good comparison table of Direct Connect vs VPN ECMP vs mesh overlay
key_points_missing: aws_transit_gateway resource uses non-existent vpc_id parameter (should be aws_ec2_transit_gateway)
No private subnets defined in VPC (requirement says no public subnets)
VPN attachment to Transit Gateway not configured
brief_justification: Identity layer design is strong. The OpenTofu HCL has incorrect TGW resource type and missing private subnet configuration, which are key components of the zero-trust networking foundation.
